title: Thinking on Patriotism, Law & Life with Manasi K
summary: Kahran and Divya talk with Manasi Khare about her habit of inventing entirely new identities (name, profession, accent, native state) when meeting strangers while traveling — born partly from women's safety instinct, partly from curiosity. The conversation moves through philosophy as a lens (Philosophize This, Sophie's World, stoicism, non-reactivity), systemic thinking in the Indian context, and her reframing of patriotism as anyone creating value rather than anyone waving a flag.

intents.display: to hear a lawyer talk about inventing new selves on the road
to think about what patriotism actually means today
